info.title: SOC Case Management Portal API
info.description: Every endpoint requires a Keycloak access token (Bearer). The role-to-permission mapping is in docs/rbac-matrix.md; the permission each operation needs is listed in x-required-permission.

post.summary: SIEM alert ingestion (creates or merges a case)

schema.description: Wazuh alert JSON, Elastic webhook body, or the generic format (id, rule_id, rule_name, severity, host, src_ip, timestamp)

200.description: Merged into an existing case, or a duplicate alert
